When you say you're not sure of yourself, is it more the fear of doing it wrong, of not understanding, or of how others see you? What small first step would let you try without feeling put at risk?”

data.name: Charte_S_objet_Titre
data.value: 1. Purpose and aim of the charter

data.name: Charte_S_objet_Corps
data.value: The purpose of the platform is to connect individuals who have small jobs to be done with young providers who wish to gain experience, build their confidence, strengthen their practical skills and progress in their socio-professional attitudes. Proposed missions must remain simple, limited, not dangerous, and compatible with a supported learning approach.

data.name: Charte_S_principes_generaux_Corps
Charte_S_engagement_particulier_Corps
data.value:
The individual client undertakes to use the tool, the platform and the referring coaches to formulate, have validated, organise, follow and have the work carried out when they wish to benefit from the coach’s supervision, assistance, support or possible intervention. They understand that this supervision is possible only if the mission is declared, validated and followed within the framework provided by the platform.
The individual client also undertakes to describe the mission clearly and completely, to specify the expected tasks, the place, the estimated duration, any constraints, the equipment available, special instructions, safety rules and any element that may affect the proper completion of the mission. They undertake not to ask the young provider to carry out tasks that were not planned, that are dangerous, illegal, humiliating, or that require a specific qualification.

data.name: Charte_S_ententes_hors_Corps
data.value:
Arrangements, missions or payments agreed directly between an individual client and a young provider without going through the tool, without validation by the platform or without informing the referring coach are solely the responsibility of the people concerned. In that case, the coach, the association, the partner company or the platform cannot be considered responsible for the organisation, performance, payment, follow-up, an incident or a dispute linked to that direct arrangement.
The individual client acknowledges that, if they choose to conclude a mission directly with a young provider outside the tool, they waive for that mission the benefit of the framework of supervision, assistance, mediation and follow-up offered by the referring coach, unless there is prior and explicit agreement from the platform or the coach concerned.

data.name: Charte_S_responsabilite_coach_Corps
data.value:
The referring coach acts as a supporter, observer, mediator and educational resource in the context of missions declared and followed via the platform. Their role is to help the young provider prepare, understand expectations, progress in their socio-professional attitudes, receive constructive feedback and draw learning from each mission.
The coach’s responsibility is limited to missions of which they are aware, which have been entered in the tool, validated according to the agreed framework and followed under the conditions defined by the platform. The coach is not the young provider’s employer, does not stand in for the individual client in defining the concrete need, does not guarantee a professional result equivalent to that of a specialised company, and cannot be held responsible for agreements concluded outside the scheme.
In the event of difficulty, incident, misunderstanding or dissatisfaction in a declared mission, the coach may step in to clarify the situation, recall the framework, support the young person, gather the individual client’s observations, propose mediation or recommend an adjustment of the pathway. Their intervention remains a support and educational supervision role, within the limits of the information brought to their attention and of reasonably available means.

data.name: Charte_S_missions_autorisees_Corps
Charte_S_missions_interdites_Corps
Charte_S_deroulement_Corps
data.value: • Before the mission: read the description, check the place, time and duration, confirm attendance, wear suitable clothing, and do not accept a mission one does not feel able to carry out properly or safely. • During the mission: introduce oneself politely, listen to instructions, ask questions if needed, work with care, respect the home, avoid excessive phone use, do not smoke or consume alcohol or prohibited substances, report any incident. • After the mission: check with the client that the task is finished, put equipment away, leave the premises clean, report what could not be done, thank the client and accept constructive feedback.

data.name: Charte_S_comportements_Titre
data.value: 9. Expected behaviours of the young provider

data.name: Charte_S_comportements_Corps
Charte_S_confidentialite_Corps
data.value: The provider respects the client’s privacy: they disclose no information, do not photograph the premises without authorisation, and publish nothing on social media about the mission. Safety remains the priority: no mission must put the provider, the client or a third party in danger. Observations gathered during or after missions may be used to support the provider in their socio-professional progress, without a definitive judgement.

data.name: Charte_S_engagement_prestataire_Corps
data.value: By joining the platform, the provider undertakes to respect this charter and to carry out missions in a spirit of seriousness, respect and learning. They understand that their behaviour contributes to clients’ trust, to the credibility of the platform, to the success of the social project and to the development of their own socio-professional profile.

data.name: Charte_S_consequences_Corps
data.value: If the charter is not respected, the platform or the referring coach may recall the rules, propose a support discussion, temporarily suspend access to missions, refuse certain future missions, or exclude the provider in the event of serious behaviour: theft, violence, threat, discrimination, consumption of alcohol or drugs during a mission, wilful damage, or infringement of the client’s privacy.

data.name: Charte_S_formule_engagement_Corps
data.value:
I acknowledge that I have read and understood this charter. I undertake to respect the mission, safety and behaviour rules defined by the platform. I understand that each mission is an opportunity to learn, to progress and to develop my socio-professional behaviour.
The lines below are meant for a printed version of this document, if a physical signature is required. The young provider does not need to fill them in online: accepting the charter through the online confirmation form, available on the "Charter" page of their account, is enough to use the platform.
